bav.faq_a1: Bav Store is a Saudi store for gaming-related digital services: currency top-ups, ready digital files and guides, and support services — with a clear price you see before you pay, and a turnaround time we state upfront.
bav.faq_q2: Where do I find my player ID?
bav.faq_a2: Open the game, go to Settings, then User Settings from the left menu — your player ID is at the bottom. Tap the copy icon to make sure it's saved correctly with no mistakes.
bav.faq_q3: How do I complete a purchase?
bav.faq_a3: Choose the service or tier that fits you, enter your player ID if needed and double-check it, pay securely with any available payment method, and we'll process your order and notify you once it's done.
bav.faq_q4: How do I make sure the game is on the latest version?
bav.faq_a4: Make sure the game is updated to the latest version available from the store (Google Play or App Store) before completing your order, so the top-up works correctly on your account.
bav.faq_q5: How do I track my order?
bav.faq_a5: You'll get a confirmation message as soon as your order is complete, and you can check your order's status anytime from the "My Orders" page in your account.
bav.faq_a6: The exact fulfillment time for each product is shown on its own page, and you'll get a confirmation message once it's done. We're online :hours.
bav.faq_q7: What if my order doesn't arrive?
bav.faq_a7: If the stated fulfillment time has passed and you haven't received a confirmation, reach out to us on WhatsApp right away and we'll look into your order and resolve it as quickly as possible.
bav.faq_a8: Reach us on WhatsApp during working hours :hours, and our team is ready to answer your questions.
bav.faq_a9: Fulfilled digital products and services are non-refundable once delivered. Please review the full Refund Policy page before ordering.
bav.faq_a10: Every time your cart value grows, a new reward level unlocks automatically — see the details and live progress in the "Spend More, Unlock Rewards" section on the homepage.
bav.faq_q11: Do you need my account password?
bav.faq_a11: No. Top-ups only need your player ID — we never ask for a password or any login details.
bav.faq_q12: What if I enter the wrong ID?
bav.faq_a12: Your order is processed on exactly the ID you enter, which is why we ask you to confirm it before paying. Double-check it before you complete your order.
bav.faq_a13: Yes. We only use your player ID to add the top-up — we never ask for a password, login details, or verification codes. Don't share it with anyone, not even with us.
bav.faq_a14: No. Digital files cannot be refunded once delivered.

bav.about_lead: Bav Store specializes in Call of Duty: Mobile and another game, where speed meets clarity. We make in-game currency top-ups effortless, alongside a range of ready digital files and guides built around what you actually need. We believe trust is built in the details: a clear price you see before you pay, simple steps that take no time at all, and a turnaround time we commit to and state upfront.
bav.about_commit1_desc: We show you the full price before you pay, tax included, with no hidden fees added later. You also get the chance to carefully review your order details before confirming it.
bav.about_commit2_desc: We commit to fast fulfillment after payment is confirmed — the exact turnaround time for each product is clearly stated on its own page. Once it's done, you'll get an instant confirmation message.
bav.about_commit3_desc: Your privacy and security come first. All we ever need is your player ID - no password, no login details, no verification codes. Your account stays entirely in your own hands.
bav.about_commit4_desc: We don't disappear once your order is placed. Our team is ready to answer your questions during working hours, :hours.

bav.refund_policy_known_note: Note: digital files cannot be refunded.
bav.refund_policy_scope_desc: This policy applies to every product and digital service listed in the Bav Store, and explains when an order can be exchanged or refunded, and when that isn't possible, in line with the regulations in force in Saudi Arabia.
bav.refund_policy_before_desc: You can request to cancel your order and get a refund at any time before it enters actual fulfillment. Once an order enters fulfillment, it's considered final and can't be cancelled.
bav.refund_policy_fees_title: Refund fee deduction depending on payment method
bav.refund_policy_fees_desc: When a pre-fulfillment refund is approved, any actual fee the bank or payment gateway charges on the refund itself (if any) is deducted, and the remaining amount is returned to you after that fee only. The final refunded amount is shown to you before you confirm the refund.
bav.refund_policy_digital_title: After an order is successfully fulfilled
bav.refund_policy_digital_desc: Once a currency top-up order or digital file delivery is completed, it cannot be refunded or exchanged, because fulfillment is instant and cannot be reversed by the provider. That's why we ask you to double-check your player ID and entered details carefully before completing payment.
bav.refund_policy_store_error_title: If there's an error on our part or a mismatched service
bav.refund_policy_store_error_desc: If an error happens on our part while fulfilling your order, or you receive a service that doesn't match exactly what you ordered, contact us right away on WhatsApp with proof of payment. We'll review the case immediately and fix it, either by re-fulfilling it correctly or refunding the full amount, depending on the case.
bav.refund_policy_special_cases_title: Special cases: duplicate payment, unregistered order, or unfulfilled service
bav.refund_policy_special_cases_desc: If a duplicate payment happens for the same order by mistake, or you paid but your order wasn't registered in the system, or you paid but the service wasn't fulfilled within the stated time, contact us right away on WhatsApp with proof of payment. We'll review the case and refund the full amount once the error is confirmed.
bav.refund_policy_wrong_id_title: If you enter the wrong ID
bav.refund_policy_wrong_id_desc: Your order is fulfilled using exactly the ID or details you enter, with no additional verification of their accuracy on our part. Full responsibility for the accuracy of entered details rests with the buyer. Please make sure they're correct before completing your order.
bav.refund_policy_contact_title: If you run into a problem with your order
bav.refund_policy_contact_desc: Reach us on WhatsApp during working hours :hours, and we'll help you review your order's status right away.
bav.digital_no_refund_note: Note: digital files cannot be refunded.
bav.terms_scope_desc: By using Bav Store and placing any order, you agree to the terms on this page. These terms apply to every product and digital service listed in the store.
bav.terms_service_desc: The store provides digital services (currency top-ups, ready-made files and guides, and technical services) fulfilled electronically right after payment is confirmed, based on the details you enter yourself (player ID or recipient ID). We never ask for your account password or any login details, at any time.
bav.terms_pricing_desc: All displayed prices are tax-inclusive and shown to you in full before you complete payment, with no hidden fees added later. Payment is made through the payment methods enabled in the store.
bav.terms_data_desc: Your order is fulfilled using exactly the details you enter, with no additional verification of their accuracy on our part. Full responsibility for the accuracy of these details rests with you, so please review them carefully before completing payment.
bav.terms_ip_desc: Game names and trademarks shown in the store belong to their respective owners, and this store is not affiliated with their developers or publishers in any way.
bav.terms_refund_desc: Full details on exchanges and refunds are covered on the separate Exchange & Refund Policy page.
bav.terms_contact_desc: For any question, reach us on WhatsApp during working hours :hours.
bav.privacy_policy_scope_desc: This policy explains the data we collect about you at Bav Store, why we ask for it, and how we use and store it, in line with the Personal Data Protection Law in Saudi Arabia.
bav.privacy_policy_collected_desc: We only collect the data you enter yourself when completing your order: your player ID or recipient ID (depending on the order type), and your email and phone number for the account-creation service, plus order and payment data processed through the Salla platform itself.
bav.privacy_policy_why_title: Why we ask for this data
bav.privacy_policy_why_desc: Your player ID or recipient ID is needed to fulfill the top-up order on the correct account. Email and phone for the account-creation service are needed to confirm the email isn't already used on another account, and to contact you and deliver the account details and password after fulfillment.
bav.privacy_policy_usage_title: How we use and store your data
bav.privacy_policy_usage_desc: We only use your data to fulfill your order and contact you about it - it's never used for any other purpose. Your data is stored on the same secure infrastructure of the Salla platform the store runs on.
bav.privacy_policy_sharing_title: Who we share your data with
bav.privacy_policy_sharing_desc: Your player ID or recipient ID is shared only with the official Activision-authorized vendor responsible for fulfilling the top-up - it is never shared with any other external party.
bav.privacy_policy_retention_title: How long we keep your data
bav.privacy_policy_retention_desc: We keep your data for as long as needed to fulfill your order and provide related support, in line with the data retention policies of the Salla platform the store runs on.
bav.privacy_policy_rights_desc: You can ask what data we hold about you, or request that it be corrected or deleted, by contacting us directly.
bav.privacy_policy_contact_desc: For any question about your data, reach us on WhatsApp during working hours :hours.
